rationale: The feature guide lists Platform 10.1.x+, app 2.1.0+ generally, its own AWS location list, enabled Model Runtime, administrator enablement and version-scoped Cloud Connected certificate/allowlist requirements. Model Runtime distinguishes zone and Global routing and may select models hosted outside Splunk. The installation guide and SAIA-9918 explicitly rule out Enterprise Cloud Connected for 2.2.0–2.3.6. The 2.1.1 workaround lacks Agent Mode and 2.4.0 remains planned in the checked guide. The limited IL2 variant excludes Agent Mode. A usable Enterprise path and feature-specific data assurances remain unverified.

exclusions: No exact unlisted pairing, rollout, entitlement or customer authorization is established.
